name: Explainer reporter: re-arm the runaway latch on width change and ignore an unlaid-out frame
outcome: Fixed the framed-explainer inner scroll in the REPORTER string: measure() takes the ceiling of the fractional body box (DPR 2 maxScrollTop 0.5 -> 0), the 300-post latch re-arms on a width change, a 0x0 frame posts nothing, and kb-explainer-request grants one post while latched; proved before/after live in dev and the production build, five small tests
